purpose: Stable test contract for App-backed Review Ready publisher (Wave 2 packet 3).
dispatchRoute: gh workflow run linktrend-review-ready-publisher.yml -f branch=<branch> -f sha=<sha> -f dry_run=<true|false>

validatorPublicApi.cli: python3 scripts/gitops/review_ready_dispatch.py validate --branch BRANCH --sha SHA [--dry-run BOOL] [--evidence-path PATH] [--evidence-json JSON] [--github-repository OWNER/NAME] [--repository OWNER/NAME] [--issue-number N]

evidenceValidation: completion_gate.validate_evidence against immutable requested SHA (workflow publish step)
remoteTipValidation: workflow verifies GitHub branches API tip == requested sha
rules: Trusted scripts checkout must use github.event.repository.default_branch with persist-credentials: false.
Issue branch/SHA may be checked out as data only under a separate path.
Branch must match issue/<number>-<slug> (lowercase slug); reject refs/heads/ and protected branches.
SHA must be full 40-char hex; reject abbreviated SHAs and mutable refs.
Evidence headSha must equal requested sha; schemaVersion>=1; commands exitCode 0.
repository must match GITHUB_REPOSITORY when provided (no cross-repo publish).
Privileged publish uses GitHub App token only; no GITHUB_TOKEN or BUGBOT_USER_TOKEN human fallback.
Private key only in create-github-app-token mint step.
Fail closed with automation_credentials_blocked when App token missing.
